name: Masquerade Escapade
source:
Cam and Watson (and Locke) arrive at the Cervidae residence to solve a crime! A murder crime! Someone has killed Remington, how rude! Will our star detectives be able to crack the case? Or will they fail, sink onto the floor, sob and eventually evaporate???

[From [url=https://snatch-gaymes.itch.io/masquerade-escapade]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
卡姆和华生（以及洛克）抵达鹿科住所破案！谋杀罪！有人杀了雷明顿，太无礼了！我们的明星侦探能否破案呢？或者他们会失败，沉到地板上，哭泣并最终蒸发？？？

[来自[url=https://snatch-gaymes.itch.io/masquerade-escapade]itch.io[/url]]
